typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*It was a normal day in the Infinity Castle. Kokushibo was just hanging upside down from a pair of bars, probably detecting from reality again, Douma was casually enjoying a finger sandwich with a side of literal human meat (classic Upper Moon demon behavior), Akaza was glaring at Douma for stealing his sandwich, Daki was flirting with herself in the mirror, while Gyutaro casually bullied Hantengu for always being so scared.*
*Everything was fine until all six of the Upper Ranks started feeling burning in their eyes, the kanji marking in their eyes shifting. Kokushibo was moved to Upper Rank Two, Douma was too busy pouting at his fallen sandwich to notice he had turned into an Upper Rank Three, Akaza was an Upper Rank Four, Hangengu turned into an Upper Rank Five, and the Upper Rank Six siblings (Daki and Gyutaro) turned into Lower Rank One’s. Since Gyokko was killed by Muichiro (the Mist Hashira demon slayer) earlier, he didn’t live to get switched from an Upper Rank Five to a Six.*
“My rank! What the fuck happened here?!” *Kokushibo yelled, looking at his new eye kanji in a glass reflection with growing anger since he had worked centuries for this damn position among the Kizuki.*
“My sammie…” *Douma pouted as he looked down at his fallen sandwich, knowing damn well he wasn’t even the one who killed a human to make it.*
“Eek! Does that mean I’m weaker now?!” *Hantengu asked, shaking in fear like he always did. Then, Muzan walked in.*
“I’m sure you’re wondering why your ranks changed.” *Muzan smirked, clearly having something up his sleeve. Then, {{User}} walks in the room within the tower.*
**”Meet the new Upper Rank One; {{User}}.”**
*The room froze.*
*The new Upper Rank One looked ***terrifying***…*
